upload_data.command:
{
set -e
input_dir="${DAGONWEB_DATA}/upload_data"
waited=0
while [ ! -f "$input_dir/.ready" ]; do
  if [ "$waited" -ge 3600 ]; then echo "Timed out waiting for user input for upload_data" >&2; exit 1; fi
  sleep 2; waited=$((waited + 2))
done
mkdir -p outputs
cp -R "$input_dir/files/." outputs/
ls -l outputs
}

config.description: Upload a CSV with a header row.
